text:
maria (design): Quick design spike — on mobile the console toolbar badges (queue count, live indicator, env tag) are overflowing into the top-right on narrow widths. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/abc123
kevin (frontend): saw that. looks like the flex wrap is weird at <= 520px. could push less-important badges into an overflow menu.
raj (mobile): on iOS the safe-area plus notch makes it worse — top inset eats space. maybe we need a compact top bar variant?
sasha (pm): agree we need a pattern. current options: 1) compress badges to icons only, 2) move non-critical items into “•••” menu, 3) hide env tag behind a tap. which do we prefer?
ava (a11y): any collapse must preserve keyboard focus and screen reader labels. If we move items into a menu, ensure aria-expanded + accessible name. touch targets must remain >=44px.
kevin (frontend): prototype CSS I tried:
```css
.toolbar { display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; }
.badges { display:flex; flex-wrap:nowrap; overflow:hidden; }
@media (max-width:540px) { .badges { min-width:0; } .badge-collapse { display:none; } }
```
kevin (frontend): that stops visual overflow but it clips content — not great for discoverability.
maria (design): i sketched a “priority” mode: keep live + queue, collapse env+region+beta into a pill "More" (+ chevron). tap shows popover with full copy. keeps touch targets and hierarchy.
raj (mobile): popover ok but iOS popover positioning needs extra work. Also don't forget landscape on phones — toolbars get super cramped.
sasha (pm): what's the breakpoint? design recommended 600px for card/table collapse earlier, should toolbar follow same threshold?
maria (design): proposal: >720px full badges, 480-720px priority pills with icons+abbr, <480px one-pill "More". fallback: allow horizontal scroll on table rows under 400px.
ava (a11y): horizontal scroll on tables is fine if we expose keyboard scroll and announce overflow. Prefer stacking rows into cards for content-dense tables — easier for screen readers.
kevin (frontend): stacking table->cards is bigger dev work. quick fix: enable horizontal scroll + show a gradient hint. longer fix: card view for small screens.
sasha (pm): timeline: quick fix (overflow hidden + gradient + More menu) for next sprint. longer epic (card view + accessible popovers + iOS safe area) for Q2.
maria (design): i'll upload updated mockups. small ask: copy for collapsed pill — prefer "More" or "Details"? also add tooltip on hover for desktop.
ava (a11y): "More" is generic; "Details" exposes intent. But tooltips on hover must be accessible and not the only way to get info.
kevin (frontend): vote: "Details" :thumbsup: , "More" :thumbsdown:
sasha (pm): consensus = Details. raj can you check iOS positioning + safe-area CSS? kevin will prototype overflow+gradient. maria will drop mocks into figma and tag everyone.
screenshot-bot: uploaded 2 images to thread: https://files.redwood.ai/s/toolbar-overflow-1.png , https://files.redwood.ai/s/toolbar-overflow-2.png
maria (design): thanks — will iterate and ping when mocks ready. :sparkles:
